Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __not__ embedded in the test tube.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded __within a protective layer not directly within the material of the test tube__.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath, oriented for reading __from the side__.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

Claim 22 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

Claim 23 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath, oriented for reading __from the side__.
